think_procedure: 1) Identify the knob’s allowed range and documented semantics. 2) Check whether any numeric value (commonly -1 or 0) switches the knob into a qualitatively different mode (e.g., disable/enable/auto) rather than just scaling the same behavior. 3) If such a mode-switch value exists, classify as a special knob and record the special value(s); otherwise classify as non-special.
